name: Penske Automotive Italy
verdict: Joint venture of the NYSE-listed Penske Automotive Group and the Vanti-Mantellini families. Nothing found.
note: Italian premium/luxury car dealer group (BMW, Audi, Ferrari, Jaguar Land Rover, Lamborghini, Porsche, Volvo and others). Announced as shorts sponsor for the fifth consecutive year in the club's 25 September 2025 jersey-sponsor note; placement on the 2026/27 game shorts not confirmed by a photo (see pull request).
